name: Rewrite texts with specific style or language constraints
description: Users asked to paraphrase or rewrite given texts with specific stylistic, dialectal, or language constraints, such as adopting a regional dialect, changing the tone, or translating into a different language. The requests often involved adapting content for a new audience, format, or medium, including converting direct speech to reported speech or simplifying technical and academic material.
